name: Series 1 Bond-Type Class Shares of ZENSHO HOLDINGS CO.,LTD.
summary: Zensho Holdings Co., Ltd. manages food service restaurant chains through segments for Sukiya, Hama Sushi, global fast food, restaurants, retail and head office support. Sukiya sells its mainstay beef bowl at affordable prices to a wide audience, and Hama Sushi offers sushi-related side dishes, desserts and drinks suited to every age group.
